findings.title: The supplement is graded as a repeat of the earlier fact section
findings.explanation: Sequential dependency: the supervisor asks only to supplement an existing brief with relevant Kuhse analysis. A careful response can add Kuhse's initial production burden and its application without restating every factual point from the earlier submission. These criteria require a repeated evidence inventory and the same categorical inference from assignment 1. Criterion_3 also compresses the source's shots at the SUV and injured passenger into 'only' Nelson also firing, so an accurate account may omit that wording. The grading effect is to fail a responsive, focused supplement for not redoing the earlier answer.
